mainEntity.name: What features should be included when designing an in-law suite for aging parents?

acceptedAnswer.text: Designing an in-law suite for aging family members requires incorporating universal design and accessibility features early in the planning phase. Zero-threshold entries and wide interior doorways allow easy movement for walkers or wheelchairs. In the bathroom, a barrier-free walk-in shower with slip-resistant tile, built-in bench seating, and reinforced wall blocking for grab bars ensures daily safety. Choosing comfort-height toilets, lever-style door and faucet handles, rocker light switches, and single-level open floor plans minimizes fall risks while maintaining an attractive residential appearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Include universal design features like curbless walk-in showers, wider doorways, grab bar blocking, lever handles, non-slip flooring, and single-level layouts without steps.
